STEP 5. Check the dome light power supply circuit at the 
dome light connector D-03 <vehicles with sunroof> or D-04 
<vehicles without sunroof>.
(1) Disconnect the dome light connector D-03 <vehicles with 
sunroof> or D-04 <vehicles without sunroof> and measure 
at the harness side.
(2) Measure the voltage between terminal 2 and ground.
Q: Is the voltage approximately 12 volts (battery positive 
voltage)
YES : Replace the dome light. The dome light should 
illuminate.
NO : Go to Step 6.
STEP 6. Check dome light connector D-03 <vehicles with 
sunroof> or D-04 <vehicles without sunroof> for damage.
Q: Is dome light connector D-03 <vehicles with sunroof> or 
D-04 <vehicles without sunroof> in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The dome light should 
illuminate.
